item.title: Tata Open 2025: Yuvraj Sandhu Moves To The Top With A Sizzling 64 In Round Two
item.description: DP World Tour: Yuvraj Sandhu moved to the top of the leaderboard thanks to his sizzling eight-under 64 in Round Two of the Tata Open 2025, an INR 2 crore event and the PGTI’s season-finale, being played at the Beldih and Golmuri golf courses in Jamshedpur.

item.title: 'Short Tests Are Bad For Business': CA CEO Greenberg After 20-wicket Opening Day At MCG
item.description: CA CEO Greenberg: Cricket Australia chief executive officer Todd Greenberg voiced his concerns over extending the duration of a Test match from five days to two, which can lead to continued excitement due to the number of wickets taken; however, Greenberg said that wicket-laden days can lead to the long-term demise of Tests as a format.

item.title: Three-day Horse Show Begins In Gujarat's Morbi, Minister Jitu Vaghani Inaugurates Event
item.description: Kathiawadi Horse Breeders Association: The three-day Kathiawadi–Marwadi horse exhibition and sports festival, the 'Kama Ashwa Show' (Horse show), was inaugurated at the historic town of Wankaner in Morbi district by Gujarat's Minister for Animal Husbandry, Agriculture and Cooperation, Jitu Vaghani.

item.title: ‘Total Magic': Harmanpreet Kaur After Deepti Achieves Historic Feat In World Cricket
item.description: Greenfield International Stadium: India’s star all-rounder Deepti Sharma made history in global cricket by becoming the first player in the world, across men’s and women’s T20I cricket, to score 1000 runs and take 150 wickets, and skipper Harmanpreet Kaur was all praise as she called the accomplishment ‘total magic.’

item.title: Football: FIFA Club World Cup Takes Centre-stage As PSG Rules Europe
item.description: FIFA Club World Cup: In a year without a major men's international tournament, club football dominated the headlines, with Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) emerging as one of the standout winners in Europe.

item.title: PBKS Do Not Have Enough Backup For Yuzvendra Chahal, Says Abhinav Mukund
item.description: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Former India cricketer Abhinav Mukund believes the Punjab Kings do not have enough backup for off-spinner Yuzvendra Chahal ahead of the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026.

item.title: Football Transfer Watch: Palmeiras Eyeing Botafogo Captain Freitas
item.description: Marlon Freitas: Botafogo captain Marlon Freitas could leave the club to join Brazilian Serie A rival Palmeiras, according to local media reports. Negotiations are at an early stage, with Palmeiras willing to pay six million U.S. dollars for the 30-year-old holding midfielder, localmedia outlet Gazeta Esportiva said.

item.title: 'Have Taken Four Wickets Whenever I’ve Played Here', Says Renuka After Match-winning Spell Vs SL
item.description: Greenfield International Stadium: India pacer Renuka Singh marked her return to T20I cricket in emphatic fashion, delivering a match-winning spell as India clinched the five-match series against Sri Lanka with a commanding eight-wicket victory in the third T20I here at the Greenfield International Stadium.

item.title: Premier League: Manchester United Beats Newcastle To Move Up To Fifth
item.description: A depleted Manchester United climbed back into the Premier League's top five with a 1-0 win over Newcastle on Saturday at Old Trafford, sealed by Patrick Dorgu's stunning volley.

item.title: Ashes: Vaughan Calls MCG Pitch A ‘joke’ After 26 Wickets Fall Inside 98 Overs During Fourth Test
item.description: Melbourne Cricket Ground: Former England captain Michael Vaughan took a dig at the Melbourne Cricket Ground surface after wickets fell like ninepins and bowlers dominated the opening stages of the fourth Ashes Test against Australia.
